home.hero_subtitle: Discover benefits you deserve, in your language

about.title: About SchemeSaathi
about.mission_text: SchemeSaathi bridges the gap between Indian citizens and government welfare schemes. We help you discover schemes you qualify for, understand them in your language, and guide you through the application process.
about.step1_text: Browse or search thousands of government schemes
about.step2_text: Enter your details to find schemes you qualify for
about.step3_text: Get guided to official application portals
about.credits_text: Built with IBM watsonx.ai at a hackathon to empower Indian citizens with AI.
